title: J.D. LaRock:
headline: A 15-year-old said no to a judge because she cared about her customers. That is what education is for.
story: A panelist from Pearson tells the moment that won NFTE's World Youth Entrepreneurship Challenge: a judge asked a 15-year-old to rent her product instead of selling it. She said no, because she wanted her customers to afford it. Then J.D. LaRock says who she is: a girl from rural Ireland who built a safe case for animal vaccines.
J.D. ties it back: these values sit outside normal academics, but they are the purpose of education itself. Confident and proud. No picture of her exists, and we do not fake one.
